source_text: Porta haec clausa erit, non aperietur, et nemo per eam transibit, quia Dominus Deus Israel transibit per eam et erit clausa. Filius hominis Ezechiel portas templi describit.
pass_a_gloss: This gate shall be shut, it shall not be opened, and no one shall pass through it, because the Lord God of Israel shall pass through it and it shall be shut. Son of man Ezekiel describes the temple gates.
pass_b_english: [[This gate shall remain shut; no one shall enter by it, for the Lord, the God of Israel, has entered by it >> Bible:Ezekiel 44:2]]. Ezekiel maps many temple gates for those who have ears.
notes: True OET; no Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel.
anf_compare: no ANF for Jerome Ezekiel homilies; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel
